subject: Animation
title: Independent Animators Find Audiences
description: A quick win: understand Independent Animators Find Audiences.

hook.text: YouTube and social media gave solo animators something studios never offered: a direct audience.

buildup.text: Creators like Vivienne Medrano built followings of millions without studio backing or budgets.

discovery.text: Her YouTube pilot Hazbin Hotel earned over 90 million views and was picked up for a full series.

twist.text: The traditional gatekeeping model broke. Studios now scout talent from online platforms regularly.

climax.text: A generation of animators proved that a following can replace a studio greenlight entirely.

quiz.question: How did platforms like YouTube change independent animation?
options: They made animation more expensive to produce
They let independent creators build audiences directly, bypassing studio gatekeeping
They provided professional animation software for free
